faqs.a: SpotHero credit can be used to purchase parking reservations through the SpotHero app and website, when and where available for use at participating parking locations. faqs.q: How does SpotHero credit work?

faqs.a: If you purchased SpotHero credit, the amount you paid for the credit (excluding any promotional credit issued in connection with the purchase) does not expire and is nonrefundable. Any promotional credit provided by SpotHero is subject to an earlier expiration date, typically one year after date of issue, unless a different timeline is detailed in any applicable offer made to you or otherwise communicated to you. All credit issuances are subject to SpotHero Terms and Conditions and, for any purchase of SpotHero credit, the SpotHero Prepaid Credit Terms and Conditions.
faqs.q: Does SpotHero credit expire?

faqs.a: Available SpotHero credit should apply automatically at checkout as long as you are logged into your account. about.text: Since launching in 2011, SpotHero has been paving the way for millions of drivers to easily find affordable parking at more than 14,000 garages, lots, and valets in over 400 major North American cities.
As the #1-rated parking reservation app, SpotHero provides easy parking for everyone, one spot at a time. Based in Chicago, SpotHero is led by founders Mark Lawrence and Larry Kiss.
Give Drivers the Right of Way
We take the Hero in our name seriously and we go the extra mile to make sure our drivers have an experience we're proud of.

We venture outside our comfort zones to accelerate company and individual growth. With a desire to learn and willingness to teach, reflection on the losses as well as the wins, and sharing and seeking candid feedback, we drive ourselves and the company forward.

We believe strong relationships are the core of high-functioning teams. We build these relationships by intentionally getting to know one another, taking accountability for our work, showing vulnerability and remembering that trust is a two-way street.

We believe in empowering people to use their unique voices to solve problems and find different routes to success. With the humility to ask for help, the flexibility to adapt and the resilience to chart the uncharted, there are no limits to what can be achieved.

We all strive to do our part in communicating openly and honestly with each other in moments big and small. This means sharing ideas, keeping stakeholders informed, explaining the “why” behind decisions and doing so with care.

We believe in respecting our fellow teammates and creating a safe space for people to get from here to there. This means listening, assuming positive intent and seeking to understand different perspectives.
Laugh, feel the wind in your hair and remember not to take yourself too seriously.
Interested in featuring SpotHero in your publication or media? Get in touch with us at

business.text: Easy parking for your employees with SpotHero for Business.

Provide safe options for every type of commute. Whether driving to the office or a client meeting, SpotHero is here to provide convenient, book-ahead parking while helping your company manage parking spend at scale.
Offer employees a way to expense daily parking. Automatically forward receipts with our expense integrations. Download a free how-to guide to share with your employees.

careers.text: Chicago, IL, United States, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
SpotHero is an industry-leading tech company that’s transforming the $30 billion parking industry. We are a dedicated team working together to transform the future of transportation in major cities.

SpotHero operates across the United States and Canada, has parked over 100 million cars and is expanding fast! Join our team to help drivers get everywhere, easier. Have a hand in building our company and while you’re at it, catapult your career and love what you do.
How SpotHero Creates Space for Life

"I have worked in many different industries, from finance to ad tech, before coming to SpotHero, but rarely an app or technology I could benefit from. It’s empowering to be able to improve a product that I am a long time user of and that people in my life use. I love how collaborative our teams are at SpotHero. On the product team, we get to work closely with engineering to solve complex problems and come up with fun, unique solutions!"

We're proud to offer comprehensive benefits and insurance packages to keep you and your family happy and healthy. Our parental leave policy gives parents the time they need to bond with their kids and be there for their family without worrying about work.

From ERG events, lunch and learns, team building activities, volunteer opportunities and our annual All Team Week festivities where employees fuel relationships to employee-led events, which include our Wordle and Mario Kart tournaments, Whiskey Wednesdays, Talent Show and cross-departmental brown bag lunches - we're always looking for new ways to have fun together.

Our commitment to allyship has been a central driver of how we Respect Fellow Drivers. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of Employee Resource Groups, access allyship learning resources, and actively contribute to our ongoing effort of making SpotHero inclusive for all.

Our belief is to create space for life for our employees. Our generous time off policy allows our employees to take the time they need. Through SpotHero’s Happy Heroes service committee, we’ve supported numerous local organizations (like Guitars Over Guns and Greater Chicago Food Depository) through fundraisers, talent shows, bake sales and donation drives. Whether you’re meeting in the office or remotely, we think work should feel good. We want you to express yourself in a way that is most authentic to you. Though our environment is casual, it’s not uncommon to see one person dressed in a t-shirt and another in their favorite bow tie.
At SpotHero, you’ll get a Udemy membership, giving you access to thousands of courses.

Grow Airport Parking Demand, Increase Revenue

SpotHero is the leading digital airport parking platform, connecting airport parking operators with millions of travelers actively searching for airport parking reservations online. With over 100+ million cars parked through our platform, SpotHero helps airport parking partners increase online visibility, drive demand, and boost revenue while making parking easier and more convenient for travelers.

Whether you operate on-airport parking, off-airport lots, or long-term parking facilities, SpotHero ensures your inventory is discoverable by travelers searching by departure city, airport name, or airport code.
Why Airport Parking Operators Choose SpotHero
Increase Online Visibility
Get in front of millions of travelers searching for airport parking online to drive more reservations to your facility.
Capture Demand Year-Round
Sell parking even during slow travel periods and adjust pricing to match seasonal and peak demand for higher revenue.
Operate with Flexibility
SpotHero supports reservations tailored to airport parking, integrating seamlessly with your existing operations.
One Platform to Manage Airport Parking

SpotHero’s Control Panel provides a single, online platform for managing airport inventory, pricing, and reservations. Quickly adjust rates, update availability, and track your facility’s performance in one place.
Parking for Every Traveler

Airport parking is a key part of the travel experience, and some travelers are looking to reserve parking in advance to save time and avoid stress. SpotHero makes this possible by enabling travelers to find parking, compare availability, and reserve ahead of time for guaranteed parking on travel day.
We support airport parking operations of all sizes, including:
On-airport parking facilities
Off-airport and long-term parking
Shuttle service parking
Valet and premium parking locations

Simplify Parking for Events, Stadiums, and Venues

With 100+ million cars parked through our platform, SpotHero helps event partners improve the guest experience and increase parking revenue by connecting fans with trusted parking near their destination.
From single-night events to full-season parking passes, SpotHero is built to support venues of all sizes with a reliable, fan-first parking solution.
Why Event and Venue Partners Choose SpotHero
Drive Fans to Official Parking
Parking associated with your venue is tagged as Official Parking—showing up first in every search.
Optimize Event Yields
Boost demand for every event by tapping into SpotHero’s large audience of event-goers to gain more revenue.
Built for Events
From sellout crowds to season ticket holders, our platform is built to support your high-demand events.
One Platform to Manage Event Parking

SpotHero’s Control Panel provides a single, online platform for managing event inventory, pricing, and reservations. Quickly adjust rates, update availability, and track the performance of each event in one place.
Seamless Ticketing Integrations

Make parking part of the event experience with SpotHero’s Ticketmaster integration. Attendees can reserve parking directly through Ticketmaster’s checkout or after purchase in their Ticketmaster wallet to reduce friction and allow guests to arrive with confidence.
A Better Fan Experience

Drivers can easily look for parking by venue, date, and location, then reserve and pay in advance through our website and app. With clear directions, digital passes, and fast entry, fans arrive smoothly and focus on the event—not parking.
